data_sources.description: NASA GEOS-CF v1 replay/constituent simulation, distinct from GEOS-FP, v2 and forecasts. The selected NCCS /v1/ana/ HTTPS route is public: six original GEOS-CF.v01.rpl files were inspected without credentials on 2026-11-09. This is endpoint-specific evidence, not a claim about all NASA services. The current download_geos R adapter separately requires an Earthdata token; it was not changed. The workbook Amadeus data sources!I13 says Earthdata login required; that does not describe access to these tested public URLs. The schema slot description also generalizes GEOS authentication; the boolean here describes the selected provider route. Inventory H13 Active is source status, J13 2018 is history, N13 global is coverage context; none establishes per-file availability or validity. Cite Keller et al. (2021), methods DOI 10.1029/2020MS002413, not a collection DOI. See geos_review_20261109/README.md for evidence and outstanding datum/ETH/TH questions. No verified archive end date is asserted. Expanded 2026-11-20 to all 16 workbook GEOS-CF profiles, with 466 bindings. The original six profiles and 168 native-reviewed bindings are preserved. The ten additions are specification-backed; fresh NASA/NTRS v1.3 PDFs match retained evidence. Public assimilation DDS/DAS metadata are separate from native-file verification. New access/decoding, service-name and geodetic gaps remain explicit in dataset_spec_objects/geos_collection_extension_20261120/README.md; no additional R execution route is certified.

products.name: aqc_tavg_1hr_g1440x721_v1
products.label: GEOS-CF v1 replay aqc_tavg_1hr_g1440x721_v1
products.description: Pinned original GEOS-CF v01 replay collection, NASA Office Note 17 v1.3 (2022), section 6. All registered fields verified in GEOS-CF.v01.rpl.aqc_tavg_1hr_g1440x721_v1.20180101_0030z.nc4 on 2026-11-09. Native timestamp 2018-01-01 00:30:00 represents the 00:00–01:00 hourly average, corroborated by native global RangeBeginning/Ending attributes. No explicit CF time bounds, calendar, or science cell_methods attribute occurs in this sample; global range metadata are separate evidence, not fabricated CF bounds. Read each delivered file time, dimensions, fill and packing attributes; this one-granule check does not establish archive-wide coverage or invariance. Coordinates have 1440 longitudes (-180 to 179.75) and 721 latitudes (-90 to 90), both 0.25 degree spacing. The sample supplies no grid_mapping or explicit datum/earth radius; AMADEUS:100004 remains unresolved and geometry ingestion/transformation must fail closed. Model layer 72 is the lowest model layer, not a fixed measurement height. p23 has 23 native hPa levels; PS/SLP retain their actual 2-D spatial dimensions. XGC has no lev coordinate. Dry-air mole fraction, aerosol schemes, columns and deposition bases remain distinct. ETH and TH remain separate unresolved identities. No v2 or forecast substitution, forecast-reference-time assumption, physical valid range, or archive end date is added. Evidence and further actions: geos_review_20261109/README.md.

privacy_profiles.name: location_linked_environmental_data_v1
privacy_profiles.description: Public metadata placeholder for environmental source Products and future location-linked use. No source PHI finding, completed disclosure assessment, transformation, or release approval is asserted. Native spatial support, grid and temporal resolution remain on each Product and GridDefinition. No participant coordinates, household identifiers or restricted records belong here.
privacy_profiles.linkage_risk_note: Public environmental information does not automatically constitute PHI. Values, time series, geographic memberships, distances and combinations of datasets may constrain individual or household locations when linked to precise residences or auxiliary information. Assess the actual joint output, audience and threat model; native cell size and masking alone do not establish privacy or de-identification. Classification of source data does not classify a location-linked derivative.
